messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Elevated 5xx rate detected in us-west-2 for Hosted API (text.generate) and several Dedicated pools. Error spike began ~1844999900, current error rate 5xx=3.8%, latency p95 up 420ms. Auto-escalation to #incidents.

Priya (oncall): acked — I'm on it. Jumping into logs and routing. Paging SREs now.

Priya (oncall): quick check: is this only us-west-2? metrics look regional.

Josh: seeing similar in our dedicated pool metrics for us-west-2-gpu1. 5xxs correlate with auth failures to AWS STS (assume role) and also a spike of 429s from obs-provider ingestion API.

Kevin: confirmed. Cloudwatch and our STS client are returning 500/503 intermittently from the region. I can repro on a node via curl to the AWS STS endpoint, intermittent 503.

Lina: customer reports coming in — CS has 4 accounts partially impacted (api timeouts / 502). Flagging for post-incident outreach.

Priya (oncall): immediate mitigations: 1) reduce outgoing calls to obs-provider to avoid cascading errors (flip observability sampling), 2) route Hosted API traffic away from us-west-2 to fallback region for latency-tolerant requests, 3) throttle retries for STS calls and enable cached creds for Dedicated pools.

Priya (oncall): ops-bot, set observability-sampling to 0.05 for region=us-west-2

ops-bot: Command accepted: set sampling=0.05 for tag(region=us-west-2).

Priya (oncall): applying quick routing bypass for hosted-api:
```
# admin API
POST https://controlplane.internal/v1/routing/override
{
  "route_filter": "region:us-west-2 AND tier:hosted",
  "fallback_region": "eu-west-1",
  "duration": "900s"
}
```

Josh: started the override. Confirmed traffic shifting ~30% in the first 60s.

Kevin: reducing STS client retries and enabling local cached creds on affected pods now. Command run on cluster:
```
kubectl -n inference set env deployment/inference-runtime STS_RETRIES=1 STS_CACHE_TTL=600
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/inference-runtime
```

SRE-rotation: we also should temp restrict heavy batch sizes from us-west-2 to lower token amplification — set max_batch_tokens=2048 for affected nodes.

Priya (oncall): done. Applied via config service. New policy snippet: `max_batch_tokens: 2048` for pool us-west-2* (applied).

Lina: CS notified affected customers with a brief note: "We’re seeing elevated errors in us-west-2 tied to third-party auth/observability dependency. We’ve applied mitigations; some requests may route to EU with slightly higher latency. Working on root cause and will share updates."

customer-success-bot: Draft sent to 4 customers. Responses queued.

Josh: after routing + sampling + STS tweaks, 5xxs dropped from 3.8% -> 0.9% over 12 minutes; p95 latency down ~150ms.

Priya (oncall): good. Can we keep routing override for 15m and monitor? If stable, we'll slowly relax. Also create incident INC-2026-1845 and start a Zoom for postmortem bridge.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-1845 created. Zoom: https://zoom.company/INC-2026-1845. Pager duty: acknowledged by Priya.

Kevin: AWS health dashboard shows "degraded" for STS in us-west-2 and some throttling reported on a downstream managed service. Observability vendor (obs-provider) status page shows rate-limiting on ingestion in us-west-2 region.

Priya (oncall): next steps: 1) keep sampling low for 30m, 2) keep override for 15m then evaluate, 3) SRE to collect STS client traces + telemetry, 4) Ops to prepare rollback plan for routing config. Assigning tasks: Josh -> telemetry dump, Kevin -> confirm cached-creds stability, SRE-rotation -> follow-up analysis.

Josh: telemetry dump command: `curl -sS https://infra-metrics.internal/export?region=us-west-2&since=1844999800 > /tmp/usw2-telemetry.json` — started.

Kevin: cached creds stable on restarted pods. No additional auth errors after restart.

SRE-rotation: note — Dedicated pools for some enterprise tenants hit transient errors while their requests were pinned to us-west-2; recommend we run ticketed customer outreach for any SLA impact.

Lina: filing CS ticket list now.

Priya (oncall): 20m update: metrics holding at ~1% 5xx; routing override remains. Recommend 30m watch then roll back observability sampling to 0.1.

incident-bot: AWS reports partial resolution at 1845000300. Observability vendor reports ingestion limits restored at 1845000280.

Priya (oncall): rolling sampling back to 0.1 and removing routing override in 10m if stable.

Josh: removing routing override now. Traffic normalized to regional distribution.

Priya (oncall): Postmortem owners assigned: Priya + Kevin + Josh. Action items:
- deep-dive on STS client retry strategy and caching (Kevin)
- add automated fallback routing rule for auth-degraded states (Priya)
- add synthetic checks for obs-provider ingestion throttles (Josh)
- craft customer-facing RCA (Lina/CS)

Lina: ETA for customer RCA draft 24h.

Priya (oncall): closing incident channel for active mitigation. Will reopen if metrics regress. Great coordination everyone. :clap:

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-1845 status -> mitigated. Recorded timeline and actions in incident tracker.
__notes: Generated Slack thread representing an incident coordination in incidents channel. Messages are a continuous string with participant prefixes as required by agents.md. No title field included.
